response.justification: The candidate lacks critical required qualifications, including native-level Japanese proficiency, C programming experience for UNIX/Linux kernel development, and embedded networking security expertise. While their background in software development and languages is strong, it does not align with the core technical and language requirements of the role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack software development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong problem-solving and architectural skills demonstrated through diverse projects
Active open-source contributions and technical community engagement
concerns: No demonstrated experience with C for UNIX/Linux kernel development (required)
Lack of embedded networking security experience (MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, etc.)
No clear evidence of Linux kernel source-code modification capability
Minimal experience with embedded systems or chip-vendor SDKs

key_factors.factor: C programming for UNIX/Linux kernel development
